title: KestrelCare Trip Interruption and the Share of the Repair Paid
content:
**Clause.** A repair-coverage share applies to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts trip interruption reimbursement, comparing the claim payments on the repair order with its estimate less the deductible: payments below half of it mean the low partial-coverage share of 60 percent; payments at or above half but below the whole of it mean the high partial-coverage share of 85 percent; payments covering all of it mean the whole amount.

The estimate and the deductible are those on the plan's most recent approved claim decision entry, the estimate less the deductible being never below zero; the claim payments are all claim payment entries posted on that repair order. The share multiplies the amount for the trip days, and the reimbursement is rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Claim payments on the repair order, against estimate less deductible | Share paid |
|---|---|
| below half | 60 percent |
| half or more, below the whole | 85 percent |
| the whole or more | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* estimate 2600.00, deductible 100.00, so 2500.00. Payments of 1249.99 mean 60 percent; 1250.00 mean 85 percent; 2500.00 mean 100 percent.
